Model K RT: Low Vol-of-Vol

Forecasts are minute-level Kalshi YES prices from the hourly price files. Reality is the official Kalshi contract result for the exact matched market, encoded as 1 for YES resolved and 0 for NO resolved.

Assumptions

  • Kalshi prices are YES probabilities. CSV values greater than 1 and no greater than 100 are treated as cents and divided by 100 before scoring.
  • Scored event outcome is the official Kalshi contract result: 1 for YES resolved, 0 for NO resolved.
  • Forecast rows are joined to outcomes by exact Kalshi market ticker when available; legacy price files without market tickers fall back to event_ticker + contract_label + strike.
  • Event tickers are interpreted as the contract settlement/end hour, matching the price fetcher's hour_end_utc -> New York event ticker convention.
  • Binance prices are diagnostic only. They may be used for strike matching upstream and audit mismatch checks, but never as the scored truth label.
  • Events present in the Kalshi price files but absent from the settlement CSV are excluded from scoring and counted in outcome_join_coverage.csv.

Output Files

Individual CSV outputs are saved next to this report in Low Vol-of-Vol: raw values, Brier score, Brier decomposition, log loss, calibration curve, expanded calibration error, sharpness, outcome join coverage, unmatched rows, and audit mismatches.

  • Loaded official Kalshi contract outcomes from kalshi_btc_atm_settlements.csv.
  • Matched 91071 of 91071 forecast rows to official Kalshi outcomes inside the Low Vol-of-Vol segment.
  • Low Vol-of-Vol contains 30603 of 71693 scored Kalshi forecast minutes. Lagged minute-level vol-of-vol at or below the trailing 72-hour rolling 25th percentile.
  • Minute volatility is the absolute Binance BTCUSDT one-minute log return. Vol-of-vol is the population standard deviation of those minute-volatility values over the trailing 4320 minutes ending at t-1, assigned to forecast minute t.
  • Each scored forecast minute is classified against a trailing 72-hour (4320-minute) rolling distribution of lagged vol-of-vol values available at that minute.
  • Rolling cutoff summaries for this run: q10 latest=0.00039205, median=0.00042432, range=[0.00025509, 0.00066640]; q25 latest=0.00040722, median=0.00044365, range=[0.00028395, 0.00067056]; q75 latest=0.00042417, median=0.00048320, range=[0.00034897, 0.00069743]; q90 latest=0.00042552, median=0.00049382, range=[0.00035663, 0.00070288].
  • Found 68 Binance audit mismatch row(s); see resolution_mismatches.csv.
